defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its DFS/counting approach mishandles which counted subtrees require an edge: an edge should be retained only when critical parts occur on both sides. Counting a nonempty critical subtree alone can incorrectly retain edges above the entire critical set or otherwise include unnecessary branches.

Its DSU/Kruskal-style approach can select cheap edges that connect no critical parts before the critical vertices become connected. Such edges are irrelevant to the minimum connecting subtree, even though the graph is already a tree.
